solution_summary: Sandvik Coromant has a history of looking to the future. Founded in Sandviken, Sweden, in 1942, Sandvik Coromant supplies cutting-edge tooling solutions to the world's engineering industries. But the meticulous notetaking and data upkeep that are required to maintain such high-quality data limited sellers' time with customers. Stepping boldly into the future as it's always done, Sandvik Coromant turned to AI to help—and Copilot for Sales , a seller's best friend, made it easy. "Microsoft Copilot for Sales supports us in effortlessly capturing and maintaining the highest data quality, always fresh and concrete in the system. This kind of customer information came at a great cost of time and effort for our sales teams before. The implementation centers on Microsoft Copilot for Sales, Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365, Copilot for Microsoft 365 to support sales automation workflows.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Sales
solution_components.role: Brings AI-generated recommendations and drafting directly into seller workflows.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Centralizes pipeline and seller workflow data for the sales organization.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Provides the core business application layer for operational workflows.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Summarizes meetings, drafts content, and retrieves knowledge inside Microsoft 365 workflows.

business_outcome: Consider account managers who get hundreds of emails a day. Reading each one to avoid missing an opportunity is an inefficient use of their time. With Copilot email summaries, they save an average of 20 minutes a day. Copilot even translates summaries into an account manager's native language for faster, easier consumption.
